title: TournamentWs
description: Messages the backend pushes on the tournament socket (/ws/tournament?tournamentId=…[&code=…]): the running state of one tournament, the same for everyone who may see it. It pushes the state again whenever something changed, and to organizers the venue devices in tournament mode (tournament.devices); the tournament's setup comes from GET /api/tournaments/{id}. The server closes it with a WsCloseCode from game-ws-v1.json (NotFound when the caller may not see the tournament). A device in tournament mode opens it with `device` (its name) and `deviceId` (kept by that browser), and after a reconnect or reload `hold`, the match it played (it gets it back unless another device took it meanwhile): organizers of an in-person tournament only (Forbidden otherwise), or a venue device session (a paired device's httpOnly cookie, see POST /api/tournament-devices/pair), which may open only its own tournament and is cut (Unauthorized) the moment an organizer revokes it; its name and id then come from the server, not the query. Only a device sends messages (TournamentClientMessage).
